scope: Analysis of sealed H2bl source fields describing all 12288 unchanged H2bh BP boards: 4096 original mazes and three fixed model seeds. Zero new trajectories, samples, optimizer updates or scientific evaluation counts.
motivation: H2bl's original LP local certificate rejects only 1 of 510 BP graph-shortest failures. Determine whether those failures instead violate simple-path geometry. Existing H2bk reports on a different fresh cohort motivate this question but are not pooled; H2bl graph_valid_path was computed during its audit but its failure-class aggregate has not been viewed.

sole_falsifiable_endpoint.claim: Invalid simple-path geometry identifies at least 90 percent of the 510 BP graph-shortest failures in the sealed H2bh source cohort.
sole_falsifiable_endpoint.numerator: All source rows with graph_valid_shortest == 0 and graph_valid_path == 0, without numerical-acceptance conditioning.
sole_falsifiable_endpoint.decision: Support iff 100 * invalid_geometry_failures >= 90 * 510; otherwise falsify. The threshold is fixed before viewing the aggregate. Report exact finite counts without confidence or population claims.

geometry_definition: The selected board contains both unique endpoints and no wall cells; each selected endpoint has exactly one selected four-neighbor and each selected nonendpoint exactly two; all selected cells form one connected component. No labels or shortest distance enter this geometry predicate.
partition: graph_valid_shortest == 1: valid shortest paths; geometry must be valid as a definitional invariant
graph_valid_shortest == 0 and graph_valid_path == 0: invalid simple-path geometry
graph_valid_shortest == 0 and graph_valid_path == 1: valid but longer paths, independently verifying selected edges exceed BFS shortest distance in every published negative fixture
controls_in_table_order: BP AdamW own numerical acceptance, archived H2bl control
BP plus original LP certificate, archived H2bl dual screen
BP source board simple-path geometry, descriptive source screen independent of numerical flags
retention_invariant: Every true shortest path is a valid simple path by definition. Check and report this consistency invariant; do not call its retention a new scientific endpoint, independent efficacy evidence or accuracy result.
design_freeze: Parent review precedes protocol freezing. Freeze proposal, analysis and independent geometry-checker hashes, synthetic-gate evidence, H2bl row/audit/fixture manifest hashes, H2bh audit hash and publication verification. Only after freeze may any failure-class geometry aggregate be computed. No source-outcome reads occur in the synthetic gate or freeze step.
analysis: Check all 12288 unique input/seed identities, 48 source jobs, original 11778/510 graph denominators, source hashes and numerical flags. Preserve every row and partition. Report total and per-seed descriptive counts and the sole fixed 90 percent decision. Keep any numerical failures in the denominator and explicitly report them. Any changed denominator, malformed field, impossible shortest/geometry pair or hash mismatch makes the analysis incomplete.
independent_check: Using only NumPy and standard library, reconstruct simple-path geometry with an endpoint-walking implementation and an independent full-grid BFS shortest distance on all 510 original failed-case fixtures plus the 48 fixed controls. Compare each to the sealed fields. The complete scalar cohort is analysed; remaining positive full states inherit the H2bl complete independent audit. No claim of reconstructing their unpublished couplings or outputs.
synthetic_gate: Before freeze, exercise valid shortest paths, valid longer paths, missing endpoints, selected walls, disconnections, detached cycles, branches and malformed token/board shapes. Compare the endpoint-walking predicate against the frozen independent degree/connectivity definition on all 4096 selections of the 12 free cells of a fixed 4x4 synthetic grid, with two endpoints always selected and the other two corners fixed as walls. Synthetic truth-table coverage is validation, not fresh scientific evidence.
performance: This bounded scalar analysis and complete-negative fixture check are CPU-only. Read only tokens and board arrays from each fixture; avoid coupling decompression and duplicate graph checks through caching identical token/board hashes. Measure wall time and process CPU separately, RSS and checked-case progress; do not infer screen cost or decoder speed from audit runtime. A 120-second wall watchdog preserves an incomplete receipt on failure, and the runner refuses any existing output directory. GPUs stay available for a later separately frozen inference experiment, with no filler replay.
reporting: Publish protocol, synthetic gate, analysis summary, complete per-row partition, all per-seed counts, independent fixture-check receipt and source provenance. Reference the complete existing negative fixtures without duplicating artifacts. No cascade execution, fresh accuracy, conditional rescue, screen-latency or population claim; those require separately frozen later experiments.
